content.comment_body: I have a [product_name] with article number [article_no]. What communication protocol does it use for a [company_name] text HMI? Can I use a third-party HMI with this [product_name]? Regards, [user_name]
The [product_name] with article number [article_no] can support Ethernet TCP/IP using S7 protocol or Modbus TCP/IP.

Hello all, I am planning to install a new 7-inch HMI from [company_name], and need a communication cable for my [product_name]. Please provide both required spare parts and the correct part numbers. Regards, [user_name]

The cable you'll need is a standard Ethernet cable. Are you planning to purchase this from [company_name]? Check the attached image for the part numbers of two 7-inch panels. The blue one is more affordable and part of the Basic range. You'll also need software, so it may be best to consult a distributor for your specific needs.
[company_name] 7-inch Basic PN (Basic Panel) and [company_name] 7-inch Comfort (Comfort Panel) are options. The connection between the [product_name] and HMI uses a standard Ethernet cable.
Hello, the [product_name] with the provided article number does not appear to have an Ethernet port. Any advice?
Are you certain the article number you provided is correct? In these numbers, there are zeros '0', not the letter 'O'. Could you upload a photo of the top section of the [product_name]'s housing?

analysis.insight_summary: Users are discussing integration between a [product_name] and an HMI, considering both [company_name] and third-party options. There is uncertainty around compatible communication protocols, whether Ethernet is available, and which specific products are suitable, mostly due to unclear product specifications and article numbers.
analysis.user_expectations: Users want detailed and accurate information about connecting a [product_name] (specific article number) to an HMI, including supported protocols, required cables, and necessary software. They also seek confirmation about third-party HMI compatibility and expect clear part numbers for all needed [company_name] components.
